data.name: Shahaad
data.long_meaning: Shahaad is derived from the Arabic word 'shahada', meaning 'to witness' or 'martyr'. In Islamic context, it refers to the act of bearing witness to one's faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: The term is closely related to the Shahada, the declaration of faith in Islam, which is one of the Five Pillars.

in_arabic.name: شهااد
in_arabic.meaning: الشهادة هي التصديق بالله واليوم الآخر
in_arabic.long_meaning: الشهادة هي التصديق بالله واليوم الآخر والرسل والملائكة والقدر الخير والشر، وهي ركن من أركان الإسلام، وتعتبر الشهادة هي البداية للعيش بالIslam والتوحيد

in_urdu.name: شہaad
in_urdu.meaning: گواہی دینا الله کی ایکیت اور روز قیامت پر
in_urdu.long_meaning: گواہی دینا الله کی ایکیت اور روز قیامت پر اور انبیاء اور فرشتوں اور تقدر خیر و شر پر، یہ اسلام کے بنیادی ارکان میں سے ایک ہے، اور شہادت کو اسلام اور توحید کے لیے زندگی کا آغاز سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: शहाद
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह और आखिरी दिन की गवाही देना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल्लाह और आखिरी दिन की गवाही देना और पैगंबरों और फरिश्तों और अच्छे और बुरे भाग्य की गवाही देना, यह इस्लाम के मूल सिद्धांतों में से एक है, और शहादत को इस्लाम और एकेश्वरवाद के लिए जीवन की शुरुआत माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: شهaad
in_pashto.meaning: د الله د يووالي د قیامت پوري گواهي ورکول
in_pashto.long_meaning: د الله د يووالي د قیامت پوري گواهي ورکول او د پيغمبرانو او ملائکو او خير او شر د تقدير پوري گواهي ورکول، دا د اسلام د بنسټيزو اصولو څخه دی، او د شهاادت د اسلام او توحید لپاره د ژوند پیل بلل کیږي

in_english.name: Shahaad
in_english.meaning: testifying to God's unity and the last day
in_english.long_meaning: testifying to God's unity and the last day and the prophets and angels and the destiny of good and evil, it is one of the fundamental principles of Islam, and the testimony is considered the beginning of life for Islam and monotheism

pronunciation.urdu: شہaad کا تلفظ شہہ آد ہے
pronunciation.pashto: شهaad د تلفظ شه ااد دی

data.cultural_impact: The Shahaad, or Shahada, is a fundamental concept in Islam that literally means 'to bear witness'. It represents the act of publicly declaring one's faith and allegiance to Allah and His Prophet Muhammad. This declaration is an essential act of faith in Islam, symbolizing the commitment to the Islamic belief system and the Muslim community. Cultural traditions and practices based on the Shahada can be observed in various ways, such as reciting it during religious ceremonies, wearing symbols of faith, or even incorporating it into daily language and conversation.
data.spiritual_significance: The Shahada holds great spiritual significance in Islam as it signifies the beginning of the spiritual journey towards Allah. By declaring the Shahada, an individual acknowledges and submits himself to Allah's will and guidance. Moreover, it signifies the belief in the unity of Allah, the rejection of idolatry and polytheism, and faith in the prophethood of Muhammad (peace be upon him). Hence, the Shahada serves as a powerful acting force, inspiring Muslims to strive for personal and collective spiritual growth and commitment to living a life in accordance with the teachings of Islam.
